scope.summary: Author breast channel group A (placement/size) per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-037), closing OBR-001: registered channels breast_volume (small -> extreme large beyond natural-population prior, design_max 3.0), breast_projection, breast_placement_height, breast_placement_width, breast_spacing (cleavage gap), each with sculpted multi-key tracks over the breast_l/breast_r masks and L/R asymmetry sub-channels (*_asym_l / *_asym_r) so natural asymmetric builds are dialable.
acceptance_criteria: Channels breast_volume, breast_projection, breast_placement_height, breast_placement_width, breast_spacing are registered as Tissue kind, group_key 'breast', region_mask_ref breast_l+breast_r union, with breast_volume ChannelRange.design_max = 3.0 (300%) and sculpted keys at 0/50/100/200/300 key_pct.
Every group-A channel carries registered *_asym_l and *_asym_r sub-channels whose masks are the single-side breast masks; dialing an asym sub-channel moves only that side.
BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID passes for every group-A channel: full-range sweeps move zero vertices outside the breast masks (no shoulder/ribcage/hip displacement).

breast_volume at design_max (300%) evaluates through the MT-493 multi-key path without spikes: a mesh-quality assertion (no self-intersecting triangles in the breast region, bounded max edge stretch) passes at 100%, 200%, and 300% samples.
All five channels are addressable via GET/PUT /tailor/bodies/{id}/channels/{key} with correct range rejection above design_max.
scope.risk_if_missed: Group A is the volume backbone of the operator's primary production requirement ('all kinds of tits'); if volume/placement channels leak outside their masks or degrade at over-range, every breast archetype (a, b, c, d) fails and the founding OBR-001 promise is broken.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Separate control independence from declared feathered deformation support, skeletal propagation, physical response, and explicit coupling.
